content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and their clones offer rented infrastructure. You get a dashboard, payment processing, and product hosting—until they decide you don't. These platforms act as intermediaries, holding your funds, your customer data, and your product files. They dictate terms, fees, and access. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, in contrast, deploys tools you own: GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for logic, Supabase for storage, NOWPayments for crypto processing. No intermediary. No platform risk. Full ownership from day one.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal exclude entire countries based on geopolitical risk, not technical limitations. Their compliance teams decide who gets access. Even where available, accounts in restricted regions face sudden suspensions, fund holds, and limited support. Sovereign infrastructure bypasses these gatekeepers. It uses globally accessible tools like Cloudflare and GitHub—services that don't care about your location. Your store runs on infrastructure anyone can deploy, anywhere. The restriction isn't technical—it's political. Sovereign stacks remove the politics.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe charges 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. PayPal takes 3.49% + $0.49. Both hold funds for days or weeks in restricted countries. Crypto payments via NOWPayments cost 0.5% with no holds. Transactions on BSC, Solana, or TRON cost under $0.10. But the real cost of platforms isn't fees—it's lost revenue from account suspensions, fund freezes, and sudden deplatforming. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates these risks. You control the payment flow, the storage, and the delivery. The only fee is the 0.5% processing charge. Everything else is yours.
Platforms rent you infrastructure. Sovereign stacks let you own it.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Platforms own your customer data, your sales history, and your product files. They control how and when you get paid. Sovereign infrastructure gives you full ownership. Orders store in your Supabase database. Files deliver from your Cloudflare R2 bucket. Payments verify via your NOWPayments webhook. Automation runs on your Cloudflare Workers scripts. After deployment, COREMERCH has no access. No platform does. You own the stack, the data, and the process. This isn't a workaround—it's base-layer architecture.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you're in a country Stripe or PayPal excludes, platforms are not an option—they're a liability. Sovereign infrastructure is the only permanent solution. Start with the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) if you need a fully deployed, end-to-end tested store in 48 hours. Choose the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) if you prefer to deploy yourself. The choice isn't between platforms and workarounds. It's between renting infrastructure you'll lose and owning infrastructure you control. The answer is clear.

Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. Write backend logic in Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. Host product files on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. Test end-to-end before going live. Configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability. Load your first 5 products. Verify webhook automation. Take full ownership of your stack.
